notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Pinnacle Monk is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk that's tapped and attacking.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
